get.summary: List articles
get.description: List every article the caller may read.

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: Filter the collection by `archived`. The value is server-set: include this parameter with any value to apply the filter; the value you send is ignored.

parameters.name: filter[rating]
parameters.description: Matches values within the given inclusive numeric range (min/max, either optional).

parameters.name: filter[publishedAt]
parameters.description: Matches values within the given inclusive date-time range (min/max ISO-8601, either optional).

parameters.name: filter[urgent]
parameters.description: Filter the collection by `urgent`. The value is server-set: include this parameter with any value to apply the filter; the value you send is ignored.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of sort fields. Prefix a field with `-` for descending order. Allowed tokens: `title`, `-title`, `wordCount`, `-wordCount`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of relationship paths to include in a compound document. Allowed paths: `author`, `tags`, `author.company`.

parameters.name: fields[articles]
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of `articles` fields to return (sparse fieldsets). Allowed members: `title`, `slug`, `status`, `priority`, `wordCount`, `rating`, `featured`, `releasedOn`, `publishedAt`, `syncedAt`, `archivedAt`, `embargoLifts`, `editorEmail`, `canonicalUrl`, `keywords`, `analytics`, `address`, `block`, `author`, `tags`, `cover`, `locked`, `attachments`.

parameters.name: fields[people]

parameters.name: fields[tags]
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of `tags` fields to return (sparse fieldsets). Allowed members: `label`, `articles`.

size.description: The number of resources per page.

parameters.name: withCount
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of relationship-count tokens (the Countable profile). `_self_` counts this collection; a relation name counts that relation per item. Recognised only when the Countable profile is negotiated. Allowed tokens: `_self_`, `tags`.

post.summary: Apply a batch of atomic operations
post.description: Applies an ordered batch of write operations all-or-nothing within a single transaction (the JSON:API Atomic Operations extension). Negotiated via the `ext="https://jsonapi.org/ext/atomic"` media-type parameter on both the request `Content-Type` and the `Accept` header. Either every operation is committed or none is; a failure rolls the whole batch back. The batch commits through a single transactional persister.
